Curriculum vitae

Academic background, research experience, teaching, and technical skills of Vineeth Krishna Talasila.

Vineeth Krishna Talasila · Publishing as Vineeth Krishna

Leinweber Postdoctoral Fellow at the Leinweber Institute for Theoretical Physics at the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor. My interests include quantum gravity, holography, multipartite entanglement, supergravity, and string theory.

Academic appointments

University of Michigan

2024–present · Leinweber Postdoctoral Fellow

Leinweber Institute for Theoretical Physics, Ann Arbor, Michigan. Research on black hole phases, holography, and quantum information in gravity.

Tata Institute of Fundamental Research

2019–2024 · Doctoral researcher

Department of Theoretical Physics, Mumbai, India. Research on measures of multipartite entanglement and their holographic descriptions, with analytical and numerical calculations in Mathematica and Python.

California Institute of Technology

May–July 2017 · Summer research fellow, LIGO Laboratory

Studied coating Brownian noise and developed a digital phase-locked loop on an FPGA for the experimental setup.
